experiments.name: simplification_epsilon_5
experiments.description: Light graph simplification — targets noise in closed-curve classes (0,6,9)

experiments.name: lower_skel_threshold
experiments.description: skeletonization_threshold=160 — captures more detail in thin strokes (classes 1,7)

experiments.name: baseline_normalizers
experiments.description: Control: restore baseline normalizers (spatial=2.0, cycle=4.0) via per-request override. Code currently has regressed 3.0/3.0/1.0 from run_20260303. Measures normalizer regression in isolation.
experiments.notes: Expected: ~73% if normalizers are the primary regression factor

experiments.name: tighter_spatial
experiments.description: Spatial normalizers 2.0→1.5. Lower normalizer = higher cost for same position difference. Targets 9→4 confusion (164 errors, margin=0.005): loop of 9 sits higher than bend of 4; also helps 2→7 (92 errors) where 2's bottom stroke is lower.
experiments.notes: Risk: may hurt classes with high spatial variance (0, 8). Compare 9→4 and 2→7 rates vs exp_004.

experiments.name: cycle_count_balanced
experiments.description: cycle_count normalizer 4.0→2.0. Baseline (4.0) was too permissive for 0↔6↔9 closed-curve confusion; run_20260303 (1.0) destroyed class 8 (-45pp recall). 2.0 is the midpoint — small cycle differences still cost, but not catastrophically.
experiments.notes: Key metric: class 8 recall (baseline 51.1%) and 0→6 errors (baseline 150). Must not regress class 8.

experiments.name: direction_sensitivity
experiments.description: Direction normalizers 2.0→1.5. Targets 3→7 (152 errors) and 2→7 (94 errors): digit 3 has horizontal strokes that 7 lacks; digit 2 has a horizontal base. Tighter direction tolerance amplifies these stroke-direction differences.
experiments.notes: Only Point nodes lack direction features (silently skipped). Effect concentrated on Vector nodes. Compare 3→7 and 2→7 rates vs exp_004.

experiments.name: finite_node_insertion
experiments.description: node_ins_cost IMPOSSIBLE(100)→SEVERE(0.65). Currently unmatched concept nodes cost 100.0, making any structural mismatch fatal. SEVERE allows the GED algorithm to tolerate a few missing matches. Targets class 8 (89 not-classified, concept 8_1=19 too rigid) and 0_1/6_1 topology mismatches.
experiments.notes: Risk: may let incorrect concepts match more easily (false positives increase). Key metric: not-classified count and class 8 recall. Compare total FP vs exp_004. FULL RUN IN PROGRESS: ~4.6 results/min with 3 classification instances. IMPOSSIBLE=0.65 disables complexity pre-filter, forcing GED evaluation against all 13 concepts per image (many hitting 2s timeout). Estimated ~28h for 7814 images.

experiments.name: combined_tuning
experiments.description: Best hypothesis combo: spatial=1.5, directions=1.5, cycle=2.0. Tests whether individual normalizer improvements compound. Run AFTER exp_005/006/007 to validate — if any individual experiment regresses, remove that component.
experiments.notes: Skipped: exp_005/006/007 all below threshold, no components to combine.
